record_id: One-based holdout row, zero-padded to four digits.
input_sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(parsed user JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), allow_nan=False).

labels.pred: P when probability_P >= 0.5; not necessarily the emitted token.
labels.squared_error: (probability_P-y)^2; its mean is the binary Brier score.

mofinder.checkpoint_selection: Author confirmed on 2026-10-02: separate validation data, not this holdout.
mofinder.archive_to_weight_bitwise_reproduction: Not performed; saved predictions are the plotted evidence.

base_oss.prompt_protocol: exact frozen no-date Harmony; forced assistant final; no generated reasoning
base_oss.score: softmax of first-position exact P/N raw pre-sampling full-vocabulary logprobs; temperature 1

gpt41.tail_rule: Missing opposite-label logprob is no greater than the last top-20 logprob. Convert that bound to a P-probability interval; round only when both endpoints agree at 12 decimal places. Blank logprobs remain unobserved; decimal bounds and the token logprob ceiling are included in CSV.
gpt41.protocol: Step 6b batch chosen-label position; retain chosen-token logprob and first normalized P/N alternative. top_logprobs expanded from 5 to 20; no logit_bias.

ece: Positive-class ECE: sum over 10 equal-width bins of n_bin/N * abs(mean p(P) - observed positive fraction). [lower,upper), final bin includes 1.
brier: Mean over all 2,595 reactions of (p(P)-y)^2; y=1 for P and 0 for N.
interpretation: ECE depends on bins and sample size; Brier combines calibration and discrimination. Intervals cluster reactions by DOI, not an independent-publication generalization claim. Checkpoint selection used separate validation data.
limitations: The base model uses the llama.cpp-maintainer GGUF MXFP4 conversion and recorded local runtime. Archived MOFinder inference runtime precision is unrecorded; numerical equivalence between that archive and the local conversion/runtime is not assumed. This implementation-level comparison does not isolate the causal effect of fine-tuning.
Intervals are conditional on the recorded probabilities and exclude API repeat variability.
864 of 1091 holdout DOIs also occur in training; negative labels include reconstructed failures.
MOFinder archive contains normalized probabilities, not raw label logits.
